criteria.description: PlayerView restructured into the vitruve two-column layout (fixed left sheet, flexible right tabbed panel), stacking below 768px.
criteria.evidence: src/views/__tests__/PlayerView.spec.ts — VitruveSheet integration + tab-host cases (WP02); .vitruve-layout grid 300px/1fr with @media (max-width: 767px) single-column in PlayerView.vue
criteria.notes: WP02 review re-ran unit suite (245/245 at that point) and chromium e2e

criteria.description: Left sheet header (name + race · classe · Niv.N · éléments) and PV/Mana pills with ± steppers persisting to the participant session, synced live.
criteria.evidence: src/components/vitruve/__tests__/VitruveSheet.spec.ts — header/subtitle/vitals rendering, adjust-hp/adjust-mana emits, steppers hidden when canEditSession false; persistence path is the pre-existing session update logic preserved through the restructure (WP02 review verified as a move, not rewrite)
criteria.notes: Live sync uses subscribeParticipantsByCampaign (WP01), unit-tested for idempotent attach

criteria.description: Portrait block with image or class-icon fallback.
criteria.evidence: src/components/vitruve/__tests__/VitruveSheet.spec.ts — portrait image vs fallback vs @error-triggered fallback cases

criteria.description: MJ/admin-only raw data editor; invalid JSON rejected with French error and zero writes; id/campaignId stripped from valid payloads.
criteria.evidence: src/components/vitruve/__tests__/RawCharacterEditor.spec.ts — invalid JSON → in-modal error + zero updateCharacter calls; valid JSON → called without id/campaignId (junk-payload case included); cancel writes nothing. Trigger gating (isMj || isAdmin) tested in PlayerView.spec.ts
criteria.notes: Atomicity (parse fully before any write) verified in WP06 review cycles 1 and 2

criteria.description: Jet calculator category selector with adjusted base %: max(5, base − 10×jaune − 20×rouge), pinned to 5 when both sous-caractéristiques are rouge.
criteria.evidence: src/components/vitruve/__tests__/tickState.spec.ts + jetFormula.spec.ts — all 9 injury combinations at base 60, floor case (base 20, 2×jaune → 5), pin case; WP04 reviewer re-derived the table independently before checking fixtures
criteria.notes: NFR-005's full state space requirement satisfied by the same suites

criteria.description: Checkable compétences (rank × 10%) and bonus/malus de race entries feeding a 'Compétences : ±X%' calculator line (hidden at 0); ticks per-viewer ephemeral.
criteria.evidence: src/components/vitruve/__tests__/CaracTab.spec.ts (checkbox lists, six-name exclusion incl. 'savoir (xxx)' variants) + JetCalculator.spec.ts (ticked sum display/sign, hidden at 0); tickState.ts imports no repository/store — ticks provably never persisted
criteria.notes: Reset-on-character-switch wired via watch(characterId) → useTickState().reset(), verified in WP03 and WP04 reviews

criteria.description: Manual ±5% modifier in [−100, +100] with reset; total = clamp(base + ticks + manual, 5, 95), tone-colored (≥60 / 35–59 / <35), min/max hints; no dice roll ever triggered.
criteria.evidence: src/components/vitruve/__tests__/jetFormula.spec.ts — clamp edges (4→5, 96→95, pass-through), tone boundaries (34/35/59/60), clampManualMod(±105)→±100, clamp-order regression case (pinned base 5 + mod 20 = 25); JetCalculator.spec.ts asserts zero store/repository calls across a full interaction (display-only proof)

criteria.description: Avantage/Désavantage toggles persisted on the participant session, synced live, both can be active simultaneously.
criteria.evidence: src/components/vitruve/__tests__/AdvantageToggles.spec.ts — reflects session values (no shadow state), both-active case, absent-field-as-false, emits, inert when !canEdit; persistence via usePlayerStore.setAdvantage/setDisadvantage (WP01 unit tests)

criteria.description: État du groupe lists every approved participant character with live PV/Mana, always visible; children excluded.
criteria.evidence: src/components/vitruve/__tests__/PartyStatus.spec.ts — renders party rows, low-PV (≤25%) warning class, French empty state; src/controllers/__tests__/usePlayerStore.spec.ts — party excludes parentCharacterId holders (generic + real Firm/Furmiaou fixture)
criteria.notes: Live updates via subscribeParticipantsByCampaign onSnapshot; <2s multi-client check (NFR-001) remains a manual quickstart step (see NEXTSTEPS.md)

criteria.description: Dés d'Aventure shared counters, real-time; MJ/admin adjust via ±; other roles read-only (buttons absent); missing doc renders 0/0.
criteria.evidence: src/components/vitruve/__tests__/AdventureDiceBox.spec.ts — buttons absent from DOM when !canAdjust, adjust('aventure'|'mesaventure', ±1) args, − disabled at 0, 0/0 defaults; store clamp ≥0 tested in useCampaignSessionStore tests; firestore.rules restricts writes to mj/admin with non-negative validation
criteria.notes: Repo-wide grep during WP05 review confirmed consistent 'mesaventure' spelling

criteria.description: Right panel tabs Fiche/Caractéristiques/Dons/Inventaire plus one tab per child; Dons and Inventaire reused with no functional regression.
criteria.evidence: src/views/__tests__/PlayerView.spec.ts — tab switching, default tab, child tabs appear only with children; WP02 review verified the Dons/Inventaire relocation as a byte-level move (identical components/props/gating), modals mounted at view root
criteria.notes: All 9 pre-existing inventory unit tests kept passing behind the tab host (C-005)

criteria.description: Fiche tab: race/genre/langues cards and histoire, editable by owner or mj/admin, persisted.
criteria.evidence: src/components/vitruve/__tests__/FicheTab.spec.ts — cards render, edit affordance hidden when !canEdit, save emits trimmed text; save path updateCharacter(id, { backstory }) matches firestore.rules owner rule hasOnly(['backstory','updatedAt'])
criteria.notes: Valeurs pills omitted: no data field exists in CharacterProfile — accepted resolution of analysis finding U1

criteria.description: Caractéristiques tab: PV/Mana/Niveau cards, posture selector (existing persisted mechanism), three category blocks with adjusted % bars and clickable injury squares cycling saine→jaune→rouge→saine.
criteria.evidence: src/components/vitruve/__tests__/CaracTab.spec.ts — three categories from fixture, injury click emits correct next state, read-only when !canEdit; posture reuses PlayerView's pre-existing changePosture persistence (WP03 review verified no re-implementation); category mapping sourced from JET_CATEGORY_META (single source after WP04 cycle-2 fix)

criteria.description: Injury states persisted per character (session.injuries), synced in real time, modifiable by owner or mj/admin only.
criteria.evidence: src/controllers/__tests__/usePlayerStore.spec.ts — setInjury map computation (add jaune, upgrade rouge, clear removes key); participants rules cover session fields (owner or mj/admin); live sync via the WP01 subscribe pattern
criteria.notes: 'none' is never stored — absence means saine, per data-model rule

criteria.description: A character may have multiple children (parentCharacterId); each child renders a mini-sheet tab (portrait, PV ±, Mana with 'Aucune magie' at 0 max, elements, carac blocks with independent injuries) persisted under the parent participant's childSessions.
criteria.evidence: src/components/vitruve/__tests__/ChildSheetTab.spec.ts (13 cases: seeded session display, null-session fallback without NaN, 'Aucune magie', emits, canEdit gating) + PlayerView.spec.ts (child tabs, PV+ → setChildVitals, stale-tab fallback to fiche); CaracCategoryBlock shared component keeps parent/child rendering identical
criteria.notes: All-zero fallback for a genuinely missing childSessions entry accepted on the merits in WP06 review (CharacterProfile carries no vitals fields; seeded vitals live in childSessions)

criteria.description: While a child tab is active the calculator computes from the child's attributes and injuries; leaving restores the parent context.
criteria.evidence: src/views/__tests__/PlayerView.spec.ts — FR-016 case added in WP06 cycle 2: distinguishable parent/child fixtures (distinct primaries and disjoint injuries maps), asserts JetCalculator's attributes+injuries+contextKey all switch to the child's on child-tab activation and restore on return, with .not.toEqual guards against half-switched context
criteria.notes: This was the WP06 cycle-1 rejection; coverage added test-only, production verified unchanged

criteria.description: Child characters never appear as standalone members in player lists, team views, or État du groupe.
criteria.evidence: src/controllers/__tests__/usePlayerStore.spec.ts — party filters parentCharacterId holders, pinned against the real seeded Firm Bintaggle/Furmiaou fixture from scripts/data; children have no participant docs by design (childSessions on the parent)

criteria.description: Seed data registers Furmiaou as child of Firm Bintaggle with the legacy stat block (PV 48/48, Mana 0/0, Nature+Transmutation, 65/50/55, puissance 5, finesse 2, aura 3, relation 2, instinct 5, savoir 1).
criteria.evidence: scripts/data/characters.json Furmiaou entry (parentCharacterId: 'firm', full FR-018 stat block, values diffed against legacy-reference/index.html buildFurmHTML in WP01 review) + scripts/data/participants.json childSessions.furmiaou on Firm's participant; seed scripts verified to pass fields through unmodified
criteria.notes: Seeding against live Firestore (npm run seed:defaultchars:admin) left as a human step — needs the service-account key
